known_risks: the X11 post-hoc diagnosis looked at false merges in North West and West Midlands, two held-out regions; the RO76 decision was informed by them
labels come from the id key only; key errors (branch surgeries, merged practices, stale codes) count as model errors or successes
development pairs are engine-held pairs from the training regions; their CQC locations were excluded from cross-encoder training, but their ODS practices may appear as negatives
engine decision ids change between rebuilds on the Splink path; edges are pinned by file checksum and folds use record ids
question: With the ODS side limited to GP practices, does a decider trained on six English regions' id-linked pairs settle the engine's held pairs in three held-out regions within the X-series bounds?

rule.combiner: X8 augmented: logistic on [logit, log1p km, LA agree (folded names equal), coordinates missing], fitted on labelled engine-held pairs of the six training regions plus their location-free copies; 5 folds by hash of (cqc_id, ods_id); located and hidden thresholds from out-of-fold predictions with FPR and FNR each <= 1%
rule.cross_encoder: X0 recipe and hyperparameters, 3 seeds (0,1,2), trained on the six training regions: twins (identical folded names kept 1 in 4) and 3 char-ngram negatives per CQC location from ODS practices in its local authority; CQC locations in any training-region held pair excluded with their twins; weights pinned below
rule.definition: user decision 2026-11-23 after X11: a hub, clinic or other cost centre at a practice's site is a different facility; the ODS side is epraccur role RO76 (GP practice), status not INACTIVE
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.false_merge_bound: different pairs auto-matched / all different pairs <= 2% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 5%
rule.fewer_held: coverage >= 0.20 and pair-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.10 (10,000 resamples, seed 0)
rule.informative: void unless at least 60 different pairs
rule.interpretation: pass: UK GP decider is fit to package as a UK bundle (same packaging as Nigeria, seed 0). Fail: report which bound; no relabelling of model errors.
rule.population: engine 'review' edges (x12_uk_finetune.py --build) in North West, West Midlands and South East, scored where the id key gives a label
rule.primary: uk_pass_all_seeds: all four conditions on the held-out regions for each of the three seeds
secondary: hidden view: the same test pairs with both points removed, hidden thresholds, same rule
control: nigeria-facility-decider-v1 as shipped on the same pairs (does the population change alone fix X11?)
linker view with one-to-one (engine matches first by score, then decider matches by probability): precision and recall of engine alone, control, and each uk seed
rule.truth: as X11: same = ODS code equals CQC 'Location ODS Code'; different = that code belongs to another RO76 practice in the region; else unscorable
